methodology_note: Study units derived from Toronto Notes source structure (toc_inventory.json / derived/scope_packets/OB.json). Unlike the N/NS/NP chapters, OB's toc_inventory shows no severe two-column OCR corruption: all 18 top-level sections (OB.S01-OB.S18) are HIGH- or MEDIUM-confidence direct TOC/body-heading matches (via TOC_OCR or BODY_HEADING_CONFIRMATION), and no unresolved headings are recorded in the packet's source_quality field. The only OCR artifacts observed are (1) two chapter-opening/section-title spacing/merge glitches -- 'ACFOMYMS' for 'Acronyms' (OB.S01, merged_duplicate_headings correctly records the co-located 'Basic Anatomy Review' heading, consistent with the N/NS/NP precedent of an acronym glossary followed by an anatomy-review section), 'AntepartumCare' for 'Antepartum Care' (OB.S03), and 'PostpartumCare' for 'Postpartum Care' (OB.S15) -- all resolved directly from the section title text itself, not from page-image review, since no body-heading contradiction was flagged. All 64 T-level topic nodes (OB.S0X.T0Y) are LOW-confidence TOC_OCR_UNANCHORED extractions, meaning their titles were extracted from the real chapter TOC but their exact sub-page position within the parent section was not independently confirmed; each such node's page range is therefore inherited from its parent section (SECTION_INHERITED precision) rather than guessed. No page-image rendering was required for this chapter given the absence of corruption/unresolved-heading signals that triggered that step for N/NS. Two non-trivial structural splits were made based on section-title evidence rather than a dedicated T-node: OB.S07 ('Multi-Fetal Gestation and Fetal Malpresentation') was split into two study units along its own compound title (SU-OB-23, SU-OB-24); OB.S04 and OB.S13 have their multiple generic T-children grouped into single study units (Counselling of the Pregnant Patient; Operative Vaginal Delivery) per project instruction not to fragment one clinical/counselling problem into its generic component sub-bullets. The closing References section (OB.S18) is excluded from study units as non-clinical bibliographic material, consistent with the NS.S20/N precedent.

study_units.title: Basic Anatomy Review
study_units.structural_rationale: OB.S01 is titled 'ACFOMYMS' (OCR-garbled 'Acronyms'); merged_duplicate_headings records 'Basic Anatomy Review' as co-located content on OB2, matching the N/NS/NP precedent of a chapter-opening acronym glossary followed by a basic-anatomy-review section. The non-clinical acronym glossary is excluded; only the anatomy-review content is represented.
